description: Synthetic offline retrieval corpus (original text). Workspace A and B live in one org.

documents.title: Vacation Policy
chunks: Full-time employees accrue 1.5 vacation days per month. Unused vacation days carry over up to ten days into the next calendar year.
Vacation requests must be submitted at least two weeks in advance through the HR portal and approved by the direct manager.

documents.title: Vacation Policy Draft
chunks: Full-time employees accrue 1.5 vacation days per month. Unused vacation days carry over up to ten days into the next calendar year.
Draft note: contractors are not entitled to paid vacation.

documents.title: Expense Reimbursement
chunks: Submit expense reports within thirty days. Receipts are required for any expense above twenty five dollars.
Mileage is reimbursed at the standard federal rate. Meals during travel are capped at sixty dollars per day.

documents.title: Incident Response Runbook
chunks: When a production incident is declared, the on-call engineer becomes incident commander and opens a dedicated chat channel.
After mitigation, a blameless postmortem must be published within five business days with action items and owners.

documents.title: Kubernetes Upgrade Guide
chunks: Upgrade the control plane first, then drain and upgrade each worker node one at a time. Verify pod disruption budgets before draining.
Rollback requires restoring etcd from the snapshot taken before the upgrade began.

documents.title: Password Rotation Standard
chunks: Service account passwords rotate every ninety days. Human passwords are replaced by passkeys and no longer expire.
Secrets are stored in the vault and never committed to source control.

documents.title: Onboarding Checklist
chunks: On day one the new hire receives a laptop, badge and accounts. The buddy schedules a welcome lunch.
Within the first week the manager reviews the thirty sixty ninety day plan with the new hire.

documents.title: Quarterly OKR Planning
chunks: Objectives are set each quarter by team leads. Key results must be measurable and limited to three per objective.
Mid-quarter check ins score progress from zero to one; scores above point seven are considered successful.

documents.title: Data Retention Policy
chunks: Customer data is retained for seven years after contract end. Backups are deleted after thirty five days.
Legal hold overrides deletion schedules until the hold is lifted by counsel.

documents.title: Customer Refund Procedure
chunks: Refunds within fourteen days of purchase are approved automatically. Later requests require supervisor approval.
Refunds are issued to the original payment method within five business days.

documents.title: On-Call Rotation
chunks: The on-call rotation changes every Monday at nine in the morning. Engineers may swap shifts using the scheduling tool.
Primary on-call acknowledges pages within five minutes; the secondary takes over after fifteen minutes without acknowledgement.

documents.title: Backup and Restore
chunks: Database backups run nightly and are copied to a second region. Restore drills are performed every quarter.
A restore is considered successful only when checksum verification and application smoke tests pass.

documents.title: Security Awareness Training
chunks: All staff complete phishing awareness training annually. Reports of suspicious email go to the security mailbox.
Simulated phishing campaigns run monthly and results are shared in aggregate only.

documents.title: Vendor Risk Assessment
chunks: New vendors handling personal data require a security questionnaire and a signed data processing agreement.
High risk vendors are reassessed every year; low risk vendors every two years.

documents.title: Product Launch Checklist
chunks: Before launch confirm documentation, pricing page, support readiness and legal review are complete.
Launch day includes a go no go meeting and a staged rollout to ten percent of users.

documents.title: API Rate Limits
chunks: The public API allows one hundred requests per minute per key. Exceeding the limit returns status 429 with a retry after header.
Enterprise customers can request higher limits through their account manager.

documents.title: Release Management
chunks: Releases are cut every two weeks from the main branch after the regression suite passes. Hotfixes follow an expedited path.
Feature flags decouple deployment from release so risky features can be disabled instantly.

documents.title: Travel Booking Guidelines
chunks: Book flights at least fourteen days ahead and choose economy class for trips under six hours. Hotels must be booked through the corporate portal.
Expense meals and mileage following the reimbursement policy.

documents.title: Parental Leave
chunks: Primary caregivers receive sixteen weeks of paid parental leave; secondary caregivers receive six weeks.
Leave may be taken in one block or split across the first twelve months.

documents.title: Architecture Review Notes
chunks: The team decided to adopt event sourcing for the billing service and to keep the catalog service on a relational database.
Open question: whether to migrate the message broker to a managed offering before the next quarter.
